title: Far-right activist Daniel Thomas jailed for slashing dinghy in Channel
summary_full: Thomas sentenced to 15 months after admitting to criminal damage to vessel that had been carrying asylum seekersThe far-right agitator Daniel Thomas has been sentenced to 15 months in jail after slashing a dinghy that had been carrying asylum seekers in the Channel.Judge Newton-Price KC described Thomas as a “publicity seeker” who had interfered with the work of law enforcement officers and lifesavers.
